name: miR-17-92a-1 cluster host gene

function.text: MIR17HG is the host gene for the miR-17–92 microRNA cluster. Its primary transcript gives rise to microRNAs that regulate expression of target genes involved in growth and differentiation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Feingold syndrome type 2 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Embryonal tumor with multilayered rosettes. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports copy-number alteration context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
